title: Finish landing the just-commit multi-remote hash-split fix
description: The just-spec commit-recipe fix is APPLIED to this repo's justfile on disk but did not fully land during the cross-repo sweep on 2026-07-26. Category: push-blocked. Remaining work: an undescribed commit blocks the push: local commit exists; describe/abandon the stray commit then re-push. Background: the fix closes the class of bug where the-desk's async todo.md render lands mid-push and splits a multi-remote push across two hashes; it detaches @ before the push loop and makes todo-sync render todo.md synchronously. Canonical fix: just-spec commit 62d41ef0.
